content.comment_body: Hello everyone, does anyone know the ways that [product_name] can connect with other PLCs like [company_name], Schneider, etc.? Also, what are the steps involved? Thank you.

Hi, [product_name] [article_no] is able to communicate with all current [company_name] controllers. You can refer to the [company_name] [product_name] website for sample solutions and details on how this works. If the third-party PLC supports S7 protocol, then you can link to those devices similarly. Hope this helps.
